name: Plant Pot Ceramic Mug
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality ceramic with a smooth matte finish, this Plant Pot Ceramic Mug offers durability, heat resistance, and a premium handcrafted look.
    - It also comes with a stainless steel shovel spoon, rust-resistant and sturdy for stirring beverages or decorative use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Top Diameter: 3.74 inches (~9.5 cm)
    - Bottom Diameter: 2.75 inches (~7 cm)
    - Height: 3.94 inches (~10 cm)
    - Full Width (including handle): 5.19 inches (~13.18 cm)
    - Shovel Spoon Size: 6 inches (~15.24 cm)
    - Spoon Width: 1.26 inches (~3.2 cm)
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Using advanced UV printing technology, the design is printed directly onto the ceramic surface with vivid colors, sharp details, and long-lasting durability.
    - Available in both single-sided and double-sided printing, making it ideal for personalized designs, names, quotes, or artwork.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - Hand wash only for best longevity.
    - Not dishwasher safe.
    - Not microwave safe.
    - Avoid soaking for long periods.
    - Avoid extreme heat or sudden temperature changes.
    - Dry thoroughly after washing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for coffee, tea, milk, hot chocolate, or other beverages
    - Can also be used as a plant pot, flower pot, or succulent holder
    - Decorative item for desks, kitchens, offices, or living spaces
    - Includes a mini shovel spoon for stirring or gardening-themed decoration
    - Wide-mouth design makes it easy to clean and refill

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A unique and thoughtful gift suitable for everyone, including family, friends, coworkers, teachers, gardeners, and plant lovers. 
    - Ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, Thanksgiving, housewarming parties, or any special occasion.
     

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Plant Pot Ceramic Mug

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
